## coupon-service

### Restart one staging node at a time

_pre-release, procedure_ · lesson 1

Staging runs a single instance per service behind the edge; restart one node, wait for the edge to mark it healthy, then the next.

## loki

### Check the Loki retention before raising log levels

_release, trap_ · lesson 2

A debug log level on checkout fills /var/lib/loki on prod-mon-01 in about two days; change the retention first.

## sms-otp

### SMS provider failover is a feature flag, not a deploy

_release, fact_ · lesson 3
